hydrogeological_relationships.screened_aquifer_and_confining_bed: Layer 3 (-4.75 to -14.75 m DMD) acts as the primary screened aquifer, while Layer 5 (-19.75 to -31.75 m DMD) functions as the basal confining unit. Layer 4 (-14.75 to -19.75 m DMD) provides a 5.0 m transitional zone between them.
hydrogeological_relationships.deepwell_screen_interaction: All 6 deepwells (DW-01 to DW-06) have their 6.7 m screen interval placed between -7.80 and -14.50 m DMD, entirely within Layer 3. The well toe terminates at -14.50 m DMD, exactly at the base of Layer 3.
hydrogeological_relationships.excavation_interaction: Excavation penetrates Layer 1 (0 to 1.5 m bgl), Layer 2 (1.5 to 13.0 m bgl, hosting Levels 01 to 04), and enters Layer 3 to reach deepest formation at -8.00 m DMD (Level 08 elevator/sump pit).
hydrogeological_relationships.secant_pile_wall_interaction: Secant pile wall penetrates through Layer 1 and Layer 2, terminating within Layer 3 at toe levels -9.30, -10.00, and -11.65 m DMD. The wall does not reach Layer 5 (-19.75 m DMD).
hydrogeological_relationships.underflow_concept: Because the secant pile wall terminates at -9.30 to -11.65 m DMD while the basal confining bed begins at -19.75 m DMD, a permeable vertical gap of 8.10 m to 10.45 m exists beneath the wall toe. Groundwater underflow beneath the wall toe into the excavation drawdown cone is hydrogeologically possible and active.

horizontal_hydraulic_conductivity_Kh.calculation_basis: Method Statement Appendix C CAL-1-P393D CIRIA empirical calculation based on borehole SPT N-values (Navg = 50). Locked baseline parameter.
horizontal_hydraulic_conductivity_Kh.notes: Kx = Kh = 4.32 m/day and Ky = Kh = 4.32 m/day for isotropic horizontal flow in the model plane.

vertical_anisotropy_ratio_Kh_Kv.origin: Research / Synthesis based on sedimentary sandstone bedding with horizontal gypsum laminations and sub-vertical jointing
vertical_anisotropy_ratio_Kh_Kv.notes: Governs vertical flow resistance and under-seepage beneath the secant pile wall toe.

derived_vertical_hydraulic_conductivity_.notes: Kz = Kv = 0.864 m/day in 3D numerical grid.

specific_yield_Sy.origin: Research / Synthesis based on drainable porosity of weathered fine-to-medium sandstone under 150-day transient gravity drainage
specific_yield_Sy.notes: Applied to unconfined water table drawdown and convertible layer dewatering.

specific_storage_Ss.origin: Rock Mechanics Derivation based on UCS compressive strength (0.5–3.0 MPa), rock mass Young's modulus (Em = 0.35–1.0 GPa), and fluid compressibility
specific_storage_Ss.notes: Governs elastic compressive release in confined/semi-confined portion of aquifer.

layer_applicability_policy.approved_aquifer_layers: Layer 2 (Upper Weathered Sandstone) and Layer 3 (Moderately Weathered Sandstone) share the approved hydraulic parameters (Kh = 4.32 m/day, Kv = 0.864 m/day, Sy = 0.12, Ss = 2.5e-5 m^-1).
layer_applicability_policy.governance_rule: Do not convert geological interpretations into unsupported numerical values. Research ranges from HydrogeologicalParameterResearch.md are NOT active base model parameters.

05_initial_groundwater_conditions.groundwater_interpretation: Static water levels measured across 5 geotechnical boreholes range from +6.15 to +6.25 m DMD, indicating a flat, hydrostatic pre-construction water table with negligible discernible hydraulic gradient across the 45 m plot (spatial head variation <= 0.10 m). The adopted baseline of +6.25 m DMD matches the highest observed borehole water level (BH01) and represents the approved conservative baseline for dewatering design.
05_initial_groundwater_conditions.initial_head_concept: Uniform horizontal initial hydraulic head plane set to +6.25 m DMD across all active model cells at t = 0 days.

06_boundary_recharge_conditions.hydraulic_boundary_concept: Open regional lateral aquifer continuity. No natural impermeable lateral boundaries exist in the vicinity. The secant pile wall forms an engineered partial barrier around the excavation perimeter.

lateral_boundary_information.description: CHD Constant Head Boundary set at +6.25 m DMD to represent regional groundwater condition.
lateral_boundary_information.distance_concept: Located beyond the dewatering radius of influence (Rc = 301.5 m calculated in CAL-1-P393D).
lateral_boundary_information.numerical_package_assignment: CHD (Constant Head Boundary confirmed at +6.25 m DMD for MODFLOW 6 package generation).

vertical_boundary_information.top_boundary: Atmospheric boundary / ground surface (+8.25 m DMD). Unconfined free surface condition for the upper water table.
vertical_boundary_information.bottom_boundary: Basal confining bed (Layer 5 Calcisiltite/Siltstone from -19.75 to -31.75 m DMD). Low permeability floor acting as effective basal confining boundary.

06_boundary_recharge_conditions.recharge_source: PreModflowApproval.md (Recharge = 0 m/day final decision. Arid urban Dubai climate; net recharge set to zero for conservative modeling).
boundary_assumptions: Constant-head (CHD) package confirmed at +6.25 m DMD to represent regional boundary conditions.
Recharge (RCH) set to 0 m/day across the model domain.
The regional water table is assumed to remain stable at +6.25 m DMD at distances beyond the radius of influence (R0 = 277.9 m).
06_boundary_recharge_conditions.boundary_data_gaps: Exact lateral domain distance and boundary conductance coefficients will be established during Phase 2 numerical grid discretization based on CIRIA radius of influence calculations.
06_boundary_recharge_conditions.rationale: This section strictly defines the hydrogeological boundary concept without generating numerical MODFLOW package instructions.

08_1_excavation_geometry.relationship: Shoring secant pile wall is offset immediately inside the 1633.18 m² surveyed plot boundary, enclosing an excavation perimeter of 168.0 m.

stage_1.description: Bulk excavation in the dry from ground surface (+8.25 m DMD) down to approximately 50 cm above static groundwater table (+6.75 m DMD).
stage_1.operational_condition: No deepwell pumping active; dry excavation of unsaturated Layer 1 dune sand.

stage_2.description: Deepwell pumping system operates (7-day pre-drawdown followed by continuous steady pumping) to depress groundwater level to target -8.50 m DMD, facilitating bulk and detailed excavation from +6.75 m DMD down to final formation (-8.00 m DMD) completely in the dry.
stage_2.operational_condition: Full deepwell operation with perimeter French drains channelled to deepwells.

08_4_excavation_footprint.description: Basement excavation footprint occupies virtually the entire internal enclosed area of the 4-sided secant pile wall (~1633 m²).
08_4_excavation_footprint.internal_offset: Shoring secant pile wall is constructed immediately inside site perimeter, with internal excavation face offset immediately inward.

08_5_secant_pile_wall_configuration.configuration: Continuous interlocked secant pile perimeter enclosing all four boundaries of the plot.

08_6_wall_alignment_and_perimeter.wall_alignment: Offset immediately inside site boundary on all 4 sides

08_7_wall_toe_geometry.provenance: Shoring CAD Plan & Drawing DEW-1-P393D Notes & Legend

08_9_groundwater_shoring_interaction.hydraulic_barrier_behavior: Partially penetrating vertical hydraulic cutoff barrier.
08_9_groundwater_shoring_interaction.key_status: NOT KEYED into basal confining unit (Layer 5 Calcisiltite/Siltstone from -19.75 to -31.75 m DMD).
08_9_groundwater_shoring_interaction.underflow_mechanism: Because the secant pile wall toe terminates between -9.30 and -11.65 m DMD while the basal aquitard begins at -19.75 m DMD, a permeable vertical window of 8.10 m to 10.45 m thickness remains beneath the wall toe through the lower portion of Layer 3 and Layer 4. Groundwater underflow around and beneath the wall toe into the deepwell drawdown cone will occur.
08_9_groundwater_shoring_interaction.modeling_implication: The conceptual model must represent this groundwater underflow consequence without prematurely overstating it as a calibrated leakage rate or numerical boundary condition.

08_10_excavation_dewatering_relationship.relationship_summary: Deepwells abstract groundwater from -7.80 to -14.50 m DMD (wholly beneath the excavation formation), drawing the regional water table down by 14.75 m to -8.50 m DMD. This provides a 0.50 m dry buffer beneath the lowest elevator/sump formation (-8.00 m DMD). The secant pile wall shields lateral inflow in the upper 17.55 to 19.90 m, forcing all residual inflow to travel vertically downward beneath the shoring toe.

phase_A_pre_drawdown.operational_mode: Initial heavy drawdown to lower static water table (+6.25 m DMD) below excavation formation to target level (-8.50 m DMD) prior to bulk excavation.

phase_B_operational_maintenance.operational_mode: Continuous maintenance dewatering to maintain water level at or below target -8.50 m DMD throughout basement construction and substructure casting.

09_simulation_period.base_model_temporal_scope: Transient 150-day dewatering simulation comprising a 7-day initial pre-excavation drawdown phase and a 143-day substructure construction maintenance phase.
temporal_assumptions: Pumping operates 24 hours per day continuously throughout the 150-day simulation period as specified in Method Statement Section 7.5.
No seasonal hydrologic variations or precipitation recharge pulses are assumed during the 150-day lifecycle in base model.
Numerical time-stepping, stress period discretization, and solver convergence settings are strictly deferred to Phase 2 numerical model construction.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Governing Source Hierarchy
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: PreModflowApproval.md is the ultimate engineering source of truth, superseding raw extraction discrepancies and secondary research ranges.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Single Base Conceptual Model
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: Only the approved base conceptual model is represented. No alternative scenarios, sensitivity cases, or speculative parameter sets are active.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Uniform Initial Water Table
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: Initial static groundwater table is represented as a uniform horizontal surface at +6.25 m DMD across the model domain based on 5 borehole observations (+6.15 to +6.25 m DMD) exhibiting negligible regional gradient.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Hydrostratigraphic Uniformity Across Site
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: The 5 geological strata identified in Soil Report SIR2023-0018 are assumed continuous and horizontally planar across the 1633.18 m² plot area for conceptual synthesis.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Secant Pile Cutoff HFB Barrier & Partial Penetration
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: The secant pile wall is represented as a MODFLOW 6 HFB (wall thickness 0.50 m, Kwall = 1e-10 m/s / 8.64e-6 m/day, HYDCHR = 1.728e-5 day^-1). Cutoff is partially penetrating relative to Layer 3 and Layer 5; groundwater underflow beneath the wall toe remains physically active where wall does not penetrate deeper confining unit.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Basal Confining Floor
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: Layer 5 (Calcisiltite / Siltstone from -19.75 to -31.75 m DMD) functions as the lower confining bed, providing the effective lower impermeable boundary of the active dewatering system.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Zero Natural Recharge
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: Recharge is set to 0 m/day across the model domain as per final engineering decision.

A_conceptual_assumptions.title: Continuous Dewatering Operation
A_conceptual_assumptions.description: All 6 deepwells pump continuously 24 hr/day throughout the 150-day period (7 days pre-drawdown at peak rate + 143 days operational maintenance at steady rate).
